myPayslips.title: My payslips
myPayslips.description: Latest published payslip and documents awaiting your acknowledgement
myPayslips.notEmployee: Your user is not linked to an employee of the company

onboarding.title: Hiring and leaving
onboarding.description: Open checklists and items to complete, overdue and due in the next days

trainingExpiring.title: Expiring certificates
trainingExpiring.description: Course certificates expired or expiring in the next 60 days

account.createNote: The account has the User role and counts towards the licence user limit.
account.confirmDisable: Disable the account {{nome}}? The employee will no longer be able to log in.

settings.title: Human Resources settings
settings.noticeDaysNote: Default notice for the deadlines the module records in the shared deadline schedule (courses and checklist items).
settings.notificationsNote: When off, the module sends no notifications (e.g. new payslip). Each user chooses how to receive them from the notification preferences.

employeeList.title: Employees
employeeList.note: Employee data shared by all applications: tax code and employee number are used to split the payslips, hire and end dates generate the checklists.

employeeEdit.title: Employee
employeeEdit.codesNote: Tax code and employee number are unique among the company's employees.
employeeEdit.datesNote: With a default template, the dates generate the onboarding or offboarding checklist.
employeeEdit.accountNote: With an account the employee sees their payslips and acknowledges the documents.

payslipList.title: Payslips and CU
payslipList.note: The single PDF is split by employee (tax code, then employee number); unrecognised pages must be checked before publishing.
payslipList.noCompanies: No company of the firm has Human Resources active.

payslipUpload.title: Upload payslips or CU
payslipUpload.note: The split by employee continues in the background: progress is shown in the jobs bar.

payslipDetail.title: Upload
payslipDetail.processing: Split in progress: the page refreshes when done.
payslipDetail.scrapNote: Assign each page to the right employee (the suggestion comes from the surname and name found on the page) or ignore it.
payslipDetail.confirmPublish: Publish the documents in the employees' area and request acknowledgement?
payslipDetail.confirmPublishPending: There are still {{n}} pages to check: publish the documents already split anyway? Pages assigned later are published immediately.
payslipDetail.confirmDelete: Delete the upload with the split documents?

myPayslips.title: My payslips
myPayslips.note: Payslips and CU published by the HR office or the accounting firm. Download the PDF and confirm you have read it.
myPayslips.notEmployee: Your user is not linked to an employee of the company.

courseList.title: Courses
courseList.note: The company's course catalogue (* = mandatory). With a validity, a passed course records its expiry in the deadline schedule.

courseEdit.title: Course
courseEdit.validityNote: Empty = the certificate does not expire.
courseEdit.skillNote: Shared skill the employee acquires by passing the course.
courseEdit.confirmDeleteEdition: Delete the edition of {{data}} with its participants and certificates?

courseEdition.title: Course edition
courseEdition.noParticipants: No participants: add them with the + button.
courseEdition.noteValidity: With the "passed" outcome the expiry is the obtained date plus {{mesi}} months. Certificates can be uploaded after saving.
courseEdition.noteNoValidity: The course does not expire. Certificates can be uploaded after saving.

planList.title: Training plans
planList.note: Progress: rows whose course the employee passed in the plan's year.

planEdit.title: Training plan
planEdit.noRows: No rows: add employees with the + button.
planEdit.courseRequired: Choose the course for every row.

templateList.title: Checklist templates
templateList.note: The default template of each type generates the checklist when an employee has a hire or end date.
templateList.confirmDelete: Delete the template {{nome}}? Checklists already generated are kept.

templateEdit.title: Checklist template
templateEdit.defaultNote: Only one per type: it generates the checklists from the employees' dates (from 30 days ago onwards).
templateEdit.itemsNote: Days from the hire or end date (negative = before). The document is handed over with the employee's acknowledgement.
templateEdit.noItems: No items: add them with the + button.

checklistList.title: Onboarding and offboarding checklists
checklistList.note: Checklists are generated from the default templates on hire and end dates; items have a deadline in the deadline schedule.
checklistList.noTemplates: There are no active checklist templates.

checklistEdit.title: Employee checklist
checklistEdit.confirmRequestAgain: Acknowledgement was already requested: request it again?
checklistEdit.note: Items with a document are completed when the employee acknowledges it; those with an account action when the action is done.
